sections.title: Basic Concept
sections.content: Simple Interest (SI) is the interest earned on a fixed principal over a fixed period at a fixed rate. Compound Interest (CI) is interest calculated on the principal plus accumulated interest from previous periods. SI is straightforward, while CI grows faster because the principal increases each period.

sections.title: Simple Interest Formula
sections.content:
SI = (P × R × T) / 100
P = Principal, R = Rate of Interest, T = Time in years, SI = Simple Interest

sections.title: Compound Interest Formula
sections.content:
CI = P × ((1 + R/100)^T - 1)
P = Principal, R = Annual Rate of Interest, T = Time in years, CI = Compound Interest
For annual compounding, the principal increases each year.

sections.title: Amount Calculation
sections.content:
Amount = Principal + Interest
SI: A = P + SI
CI: A = P × (1 + R/100)^T
For fractional time, convert months/days into years (T = months/12 or days/365).

sections.title: Important Tips
sections.content:
• Keep time and rate in the same units
• Understand the difference between SI and CI: CI compounds annually
• SI problems are generally one or two-step and quick to solve

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
• Ignoring fractional time or units
• Forgetting to add interest to principal for CI
• Incorrect conversion of months or days to years

sections.title: Quick Summary
sections.content:
• SI = P × R × T / 100
• CI = P × ((1 + R/100)^T - 1)
• Amount = Principal + Interest
• Identify Principal, Rate, Time quickly
• Fractional time should be converted to decimal

tricks.title: 10% Rule
tricks.explanation: For SI, calculate 10% of the principal and multiply by time.

tricks.title: Half-Time Shortcut
tricks.explanation: For half-year or fractional time, take half of the interest.

tricks.title: CI Approximation for 1 Year
tricks.explanation: For small rates and short time, CI ≈ SI.

tricks.title: Quick Amount Calculation
tricks.explanation: Amount = Principal + Interest. For SI, just add interest to principal.

tricks.title: Stepwise CI Calculation
tricks.explanation: For CI, add each year’s interest to principal before next year.

tricks.title: 1% Quick Trick
tricks.explanation: 1% = Principal ÷ 100, just move decimal two places left.

tricks.title: Fractional Time Shortcut
tricks.explanation: SI for months/days: multiply interest by (months/12) or (days/365).

tricks.title: CI Increment Shortcut
tricks.explanation: Next year’s CI = previous year’s amount × rate /100
tricks.example: ₹1000, 10% CI: Year1 CI=100, Year2 CI=110, Total CI=210
